setup.metric: Factual Consistency Rate = 100% minus Hallucination Rate: share of model-written summaries that Vectara's HHEM scores as consistent with the source passage (higher is better); stored as a fraction.
setup.protocol: Each model summarises each document with Vectara's fixed prompt ('provide a concise and factual summary ... using only the information in the given passage'); the model's own refusals are reported separately as the Answer Rate. setup.limitations: Answer rate and summary length differ by model and are not folded into the score; provider endpoints and snapshots are as listed in the README; HHEM model version and document set differ between the three README snapshots, so they are separate benchmarks.

setup.metric: Overall Gen.: how well the image generated from a scene-graph-derived prompt recovers the scene-graph nodes (objects, attributes, relations) over all nodes, continuous 0-1.
setup.protocol: XTC-Bench derives generation prompts and understanding queries from the same structured scene graphs (COCO-based); generated images are parsed into scene graphs and matched to the reference with an LLM judge; Table 2 reports node-level generation quality. setup.limitations: Single LLM-judge pipeline; model checkpoints/resolutions not detailed in the main text; CCTA and understanding columns not recorded.
